evaluations.question: What is the primary role of the Transformer self-attention mechanism?
evaluations.expected_answer: It computes pairwise attention weights across all tokens in a sequence simultaneously, allowing the model to dynamically weight the relevance of every token regardless of distance.

evaluations.expected_answer: To monitor operational unit economics, detect latency spikes or regressions, enforce rate limits, prevent prompt injection runaway costs, and budget infrastructure scaling.

evaluations.question: How does Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) differ from WordPiece tokenization?
evaluations.expected_answer: BPE merges the most frequent adjacent symbol pair based on raw frequency counts, whereas WordPiece selects the pair that maximizes the likelihood of the language model training data.

evaluations.question: What is the benefit of building a provider-agnostic LLM client interface?
evaluations.expected_answer: It abstracts vendor-specific API implementations, enabling hot-swapping between hosted models (OpenAI, Gemini) and local weights (Ollama) without breaking business application code.
evaluations.generated_answer: A provider-agnostic LLM interface abstracts vendor-specific API implementations, enabling seamless hot-swapping between hosted APIs and local Ollama models without breaking application code.
